job: Decide what waits for an owner, one case at a time, without losing your place in the queue.
purpose: An app screen: the queue grouped by kind with ages and an urgent deadline, the current case beside it (brief, evidence, an agent's drafted reason, reason and a commit named for its effect). A commit leaves the queue at once and is held for 10 seconds in a toast; Undo or Ctrl+Z puts the case back. Below 800px it is list, then case, with a way back. A viewer reads every case and is told who decides; decided cases collect in Decided today.
useWhen: Several requests or agent proposals wait for one person or role: credits, hosts, limits, changes.
Each decision needs a reason that someone reads later, and a few seconds to take it back.

avoidWhen.when: One decision reached from a link or a notification, or one whose reach needs a preview.
The person answers from an email or chat link without signing in.
The items are records to sort, filter and act on in bulk.
